'''Yoel Margalith''' ({{Langx|he|יואל מרגלית}}; February 1933 – 2011) was an Israeli researcher.<ref>https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-2454614,00.html</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://brill.com/view/journals/ijee/56/3-4/article-p449_14.xml|title=Remembering Prof. Yoel Margalith|first1=Ido|last1=Tsurim|first2=Alon|last2=Silberbush|first3=Leon|last3=Blaustein|date=May 6, 2010|journal=Israel Journal of Ecology and Evolution|volume=56|issue=3–4|pages=449–450|via=brill.com|doi=10.1560/IJEE.56.3-4.449|url-access=subscription}}</ref> He was a professor at the [[Ben-Gurion University of the Negev]].<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.israel21c.org/mr-mosquito-makes-his-mark-2/|title='Mr. Mosquito' makes his mark|date=April 13, 2003|website=ISRAEL21c}}</ref>

==Biography==
Yoel Margalith was born in February 1933 in [[Čantavir]], [[Yugoslavia]].<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://israeled.org/biologist-yoel-margalith-passes-away/|title=Biologist Yoel Margalith Passes Away|first=C. I. E.|last=Staff|date=April 2, 2022|website=CIE}}</ref> Yoel survived the Bergen-Belsen concentration camp during the holocaust. In 1948, he emigrated to [[Israel]] with his family.<ref name="auto1"/> Margalith attended the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]].<ref name="auto"/>

Margalith discovered ''[[Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis]]'' and was given the name, Mr. Mosquito, due to this discovery.<ref name="auto1"/><ref name="auto"/><ref>{{cite journal | url=https://sfamjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/pdf/10.1046/j.1462-2920.2003.00503.x | doi=10.1046/j.1462-2920.2003.00503.x | title=Enduring toxicity of transgenic Anabaena PCC 7120 expressing mosquito larvicidal genes from Bacillus thuringiensis SSP. Israelensis+ | year=2003 | last1=Manasherob | first1=Robert | last2=Otieno-Ayayo | first2=Zachariah Ngalo | last3=Ben-Dov | first3=Eitan | last4=Miaskovsky | first4=Rina | last5=Boussiba | first5=Sammy | last6=Zaritsky | first6=Arieh | journal=Environmental Microbiology | volume=5 | issue=10 | pages=997–1001 | pmid=14510853 | url-access=subscription }}</ref>
